def choose_move(observation):
    pos = observation.get("position", [0, 0])
    dx, dy = 0, 0

    resource_pos = observation.get("resource", None)
    if resource_pos:
        if resource_pos != pos:
            dx = (resource_pos[0] > pos[0]) - (resource_pos[0] < pos[0])
            dy = (resource_pos[1] > pos[1]) - (resource_pos[1] < pos[1])
        return [dx, dy]

    enemies = observation.get("enemies", [])
    if enemies:
        closest_enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: (e[0]-pos[0])**2 + (e[1]-pos[1])**2)
        dx = (closest_enemy[0] > pos[0]) - (closest_enemy[0] < pos[0])
        dy = (closest_enemy[1] > pos[1]) - (closest_enemy[1] < pos[1])
        return [dx, dy]

    goal = observation.get("territory_goal", None)
    if goal:
        if goal != pos:
            dx = (goal[0] > pos[0]) - (goal[0] < pos[0])
            dy = (goal[1] > pos[1]) - (goal[1] < pos[1])
        return [dx, dy]

    return [0, 0]
